note: Jobs of .github/workflows/ci.yml that the main-run reuse (scripts/quality/ci_reuse.py) requires to have passed in a pull request run. The names are the expanded job names. A pull request run may hold other jobs only when they are listed in skipped_in_pull_request_runs; any other job that is not successful stops the reuse. scripts/quality/run_ci_reuse_e2e.py keeps this list equal to the jobs of the workflow.
skipped_in_pull_request_runs: Quick Gates of a Reused Result
